failure.title: Mixed read API deciding p95 exceeded the unchanged latency budget
failure.note: The exact report and environment show three real 25-VU runs with 945, 1072, and 1061 contract-valid HTTP 200 samples and zero errors. Their p95 values were 503.815125, 440.584125, and 417.389833 milliseconds; the real median deciding run exceeded 250 milliseconds.
failure.diagnosis: The unchanged NFR-PERF-001 gate is genuinely red at 440.584125 milliseconds p95 despite zero request errors. NFR-PERF-006 in the same process proves PostgreSQL execution p95 at 0.10 milliseconds and sequential repository/API p95 at or below 22.593167 milliseconds, isolating concurrency queueing rather than slow SQL. The 25-VU mix shares a ten-connection pool while client detail performs a lookup plus a five-query fanout and today had independent reads serialized. The historical aggregate cannot honestly name one dominant route, so the corrected harness adds per-route attribution for the rerun.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
